box.highlights: East Islip 43, Kings Park 9: Thomas Costarelli completed 3 of 4 passes for 84 yards and a touchdown and rushed for 44 yards and a touchdown to lead East Islip in its Suffolk III opener. Ryan Parker added 29 rushing yards and two touchdowns on six carries and Jake Simmons rushed for 43 yards and a touchdown on six carries. Andrew Cooper's game-opening 86-yard kick return set up Parker's first touchdown. Matt Mcintee had two catches for 73 yards and a touchdown. Sebastian Regis posted four tackles for loss. Aidan Barbosa rushed for 79 yards and a touchdown on nine carries for Kings Park.
Half Hollow Hills West 48, East Islip 33: Joseph Filardi was 28-for-42 for 531 yards and seven touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills West in Suffolk III.

East Islip 23, Westhampton 20: Matthew McIntee's interception sealed the win for East Islip in Suffolk III on Friday. Anthony Mariani kicked a 25-yard field goal with 9:15 left in the fourth quarter to put East Islip ahead 23-20. Thomas Costarelli completed 10 of 18 passes for 142 yards and a touchdown for East Islip (2-1). Westhampton is 2-1. Sebastian Regis had eight tackles, three for a loss and two sacks.

Sayville 20, East Islip 13: Kyle Messina made an interception with 1:40 remaining in the game to seal the win for host Sayville (4-0) over East Islip (2-2) in Suffolk III football on Saturday. Messina also rushed for a touchdown. Jake Tripptree threw two touchdowns, one to Tony Cantaldi for 44 yards and another to Dylan Kent for 29 yards. Kent finished with 112 yards, one touchdown and four receptions. Mikey Sands led Sayville with 10 tackles and Jackson Neugebaurer had seven tackles.

East Islip 45, Smithtown West 14: Thomas Costarelli threw three touchdown passes and rushed for two touchdowns to lead East Islip (4-2) in Suffolk III. Andrew Cooper rushed for 138 yards, Ryan Parker caught two touchdown passes and made eight tackles and Matt Ferraro and Jack Kalinowski each grabbed interceptions. Brayden Stahl threw a 65-yard touchdown pass to Jack Melore for Smithtown West (2-4).

East Islip 41, Harborfields 7: Thomas Costarelli threw two touchdown passes and added a rushing touchdown to lead East Islip (5-2) in Suffolk III. Andrew Cooper scored two rushing touchdowns, Matt Ferraro had two receiving touchdowns and Sebastian Regis had two sacks and 3 tackles for loss. Nicholas Markowski scored a rushing touchdown for Harborfields (4-3).

East Islip 48, Eastport-South Manor 7: Thomas Costarelli completed 4 of 5 passes for 113 yards and three touchdowns and added a 15-yard rushing score to lead visiting East Islip in Suffolk III. Andrew Cooper had six carries for 79 yards and two touchdowns and tallied three tackles for loss and Jake Simmons rushed for 93 yards and a TD. Matt McIntee, Ryan Parker and Matt Baldino each caught a TD pass. McIntee and Jack Kalinoswki each had interception and Simmons and Dylan Bayer each had a sack for East Islip (6-2). Daniel Odell rushed for a 15-yard score for Eastport-South Manor (3-5).

East Islip 35, Harborfields 12: Andrew Cooper ran for 110 yards and two touchdowns on 10 carries to lead host No. 2 East Islip (7-2) over No. 7 Harborfields (4-5) in the Suffolk III quarterfinals. Ryan Parker rushed for 85 yards and two touchdowns on 14 carries. Jack Kalinowski intercepted a pass on fourth down in the fourth quarter. Jaden Schmidt and Charlie Heffernan each had a sack. East Islip will host No. 3 Westhampton (6-3) on Friday in the semifinals.

East Islip 17, Westhampton 0: Matt McIntee had 103 receiving yards, including an 83-yard touchdown catch as No. 2 East Islip defeated No. 3 Westhampton (6-4) in the Suffolk III semifinals. Thomas Costarelli had 133 passing yards and a touchdown. Sebastian Regis had two sacks. East Islip (8-2) will face the winner of No. 1 Sayville and No. 4 Half Hollow Hills West at 4 p.m. Friday, Nov. 17, at Stony Brook University.

East Islip 17, Sayville 7
Andrew Cooper scored two fourth quarter touchdowns as No. 2 East Islip (9-2) defeated  No. 1 Sayville (10-1) in the Suffolk Division III final at Stony Brook University. Thomas Costarelli was 16 of 23 passing for 168 yards and a touchdown. He also rushed for 74 yards on 18 carries. Matt McIntee had 7 receptions for 82 yards for East Islip. Sayville had its 22-game winning streak snapped. This is the ninth Suffolk title for East Islip.

East Islip 19, South Side 14
Thomas Costarelli completed nine of 19 passes for 244 yards and three touchdowns as East Islip (10-2) defeated South Side (10-2) in the Long Island Class III championship. Costarelli also ran for 98 yards on 16 carries. Matt McIntee had seven receptions for 156 yards and two touchdowns. Matt Ferraro had an 80 yard reception for a touchdown for East Islip on the game's first play from scrimmage. Sebastian Regis and Charlie Heffernan had sacks for the winners. This is East Islip's second Long Island championship.
